reason: It directly implements the cooldown check (last_attempted_at/last_delivered_at vs cooldown_minutes) and the daily_run_cap check, returning 'cooldown' or 'daily_cap' as the skipped reason.
The question is about products lacking a search vector; this symbol handles orders (set_product_search_document_values is the product one).
ValidationFailureError converts a Django ValidationError into a JsonableError using only error.messages[0] as the message, and exposes the full error.message_dict as the 'errors' data field.
It builds the redirects from /integrations/{slug} to /integrations/category/{slug} for each integration category slug, which is the behavior asked about.
It recursively collects members of the can_manage_billing group, filters out bots, sorts their delivery emails and joins them into one comma-separated string.
resolve_currency loads the voucher's channel listing for the queried channel slug and returns its currency (None if no channel or listing).
RequireReallyDeployed is a logging.Filter whose filter() returns settings.PRODUCTION, so records are only emitted in production.
run_optimize_table checks whether an optimize query with the same unique_name is already running on the cluster and, if so, calls sleep_until_finished to wait for it instead of starting a new one.
It sums RealmCount 'invites_sent::day' values for the given realms over the last `days` days as an upper bound, and returns that sum as an int (0 if None).
This function marks unread messages in a stream/topic as read, not messages from a muted user; do_mark_muted_user_messages_as_read is the one that filters by message__sender=muted_user.
The POST `refresh` action calls `instance.rotate_access_token()` to issue a new token and expire the old one for a shared dashboard/insight (and notebook/recording), logging 'access token refreshed'.

_print_execution returns the 'sensitive_values' skip reason when any parameter key ends with '_sensitive', so the execution is not shipped for EXPLAIN; the caller then clears the slot and skips the enqueue.
It probes the negative blocklist's row count, compares it to NEGATIVE_BLOCKLIST_LIMIT, and records a span attribute and Prometheus counter when truncation means sessions are no longer excluded.

OrderFilterInput is the filter input for regular orders (OrderFilter), not draft orders; the draft orders query uses OrderDraftFilterInput and resolve_draft_orders, which handle pagination, search and filtering.
It takes the first post, iterates code blocks, keeps only 'auto'/'yaml' syntax ones, parses YAML, and picks the first that passes is_blueprint_config.
Product.resolve_charge_taxes determines charge_taxes from the product's tax_class_id, falling back to the product type's tax class, via ProductChargeTaxesByTaxClassIdLoader.

It sends the supplied message requests via do_send_messages, records a REALM_PROPERTY_CHANGED audit log with old/new level and sent message IDs, and then saves the new level to realm.zulip_update_announcements_level using update_fields, all in an atomic transaction.
It only computes a user's effective project membership level; the decision on who may restrict a dashboard is made by UserDashboardPermissions.can_restrict, which merely uses this value as one input.
store_value_in_metadata merges key/value items into a metadata dict and has nothing to do with sort order or reordering after deletion; SortableModel.delete is the relevant symbol.
It gets the product's stocks in the channel/country, annotates available quantity, and returns True if any variant has nonzero available quantity.
It connects to Temporal with a timeout, creates a semaphore for concurrency limiting, and dispatches the batch of alert delivery workflow starts via gather, raising if any are not accepted.

MutationProgress.observe declares a batch stuck only when attempts keep failing and no part has completed for stall_timeout seconds, which separates a stall from a slow run. It also applies a visibility timeout and a wait deadline.

It computes the set of person property names the requesting user lacks write access to, via get_non_writable_property_names for PERSON type, and is used by update, update_property and delete_property.
On fulfillment creation it gets webhooks for FULFILLMENT_CREATED and calls self.trigger_webhooks_async with the fulfillment payload generator to dispatch the async event.

This function only returns the server's supported permission settings; it does not handle the case where the client's expected old value mismatches the current value (that is validate_group_setting_value_change, which raises PreviousSettingValueMismatchedError).
_create_order is the step that runs after payment: it builds the order, attaches lines, allocates stocks and preorders, copies checkout metadata, and only then calls order.save().

This task selects fully authorized checkouts (authorize_status=FULL) and dispatches them to automatic_checkout_completion_task, excluding those older than now - settings.AUTOMATIC_CHECKOUT_COMPLETION_OLDEST_MODIFIED (documented as 30 days).
It queries Message by realm and sender=user to collect IDs, moves them to archive via move_messages_to_archive, and passes a skip_notify flag controlling notification.
__init__ stores text and truncated, and sets _added_bytes clamped to be non-negative; byte_size is len(text) + _added_bytes, so the constructor inputs determine the reported size.
It picks the country-level or channel-level tax_calculation_strategy and falls back to FLAT_RATES, which is the flat-rates versus tax-app decision.
ProductChannelListing.resolve_channel loads the channel for a product channel listing via ChannelByIdLoader using root.channel_id.

This resolver returns the is_available_for_purchase state, the admin-set flag that keeps a product publicly visible but blocks purchase. It only delegates to the model method, and the matching description sits on the field definition.
get_property_value returns the 'value' field of a property from either a dict or an object attribute via get_from_dict_or_attr, which is what the question describes.
clean sets the _already_decrypted semaphore so to_python skips decrypting an already-decrypted value during form/field cleaning, then removes it.

_add_actors_selection sets the output columns actor_id and variant, and adds matching_events (the events of the step reached, via matched_events_array[step_reached + 1]) when include_recordings is true.

The function never checks the token's third-party access type. With no app and a non-staff caller it returns [] only if the user owns the payment, and otherwise raises PermissionDenied, so it doesn't match the scenario described.
It backfills recent stream messages as UserMessage rows for a new user and decides which stay unread (onboarding-tracked ones, or the 20 most recent if none tracked).
It reads the avatar attribute mapped in AUTH_LDAP_USER_ATTR_MAP from the LDAP user, checks it is new, then uploads it via upload_avatar_image and updates the avatar fields and hash.
get_avatar_field implements the decision logic: system bot static avatars, returning None when client_gravatar applies, user-uploaded/jdenticon paths, and gravatar fallback, all depending on medium.
It folds column names to lowercase, collects names that repeat or differ only by case, and raises DuplicateOutputColumnError, which hogql_table calls before any write.

This is only a thin Temporal activity wrapper that delegates to deliver_alert_notifications and converts AlertThreadBusyError into a non-retryable ApplicationError; the actual Slack posting logic lives in the delegated function, not here.

When the case lookup returns nothing, the handler acks and responds with an ephemeral message saying the user cannot submit feedback because the case does not exist, then returns without opening the modal.
In _append_set_limit_and_offset, a SelectSetQuery with limit_with_ties triggers _unsupported('TRINO_SET_WITH_TIES_UNSUPPORTED', 'WITH TIES is not supported on Trino set queries.').
can_void returns true only when the payment is not charged (charge_status NOT_CHARGED) and is authorized, which is exactly the void-eligibility logic based on authorization and charge status.
It looks up the cache key f"{PLUGIN_ID}.{access_token}", falls back to fetching from the user info endpoint, and returns None when neither the cache nor the fetch yields data (as its comment notes).

MenuItem.resolve_collection returns None for non-permitted requestors when the channel is inactive or the collection's channel listing is missing or not visible, which is exactly the hiding logic asked about.
For session-aggregated actors, it collects each row's person_id, looks up the persons via PersonStrategy.get_actors, and replaces the person_id column with the person details.
can_move_messages_within_channel checks whether a user may move messages within a channel; it does not look up or auto-create streams (that is create_stream_if_needed / ensure_stream).
StateTranslated.__call__ looks up the entity's state and returns its localized translation via async_translate_state instead of the raw state value.
create_subscription_events builds RealmAuditLog SUBSCRIPTION_CREATED entries for every stream subscription when the export lacks zerver_realmauditlog (e.g. Slack), exactly what the question asks.
do_marketing_unsubscribe is the function that actually sets enable_marketing_emails to False when the marketing unsubscribe link is used.

It builds querysets of Attachment and ArchivedAttachment rows older than N weeks that are not referenced by any Message, ScheduledMessage, or ArchivedMessage, which is exactly the cleanup lookup described.
It pops the legacy offset_type and negates the offset when it is 'before', which converts the old before/after setting into a signed offset.

get_table returns the Table object for the name; on a miss it raises TableAccessDeniedError if the table is denied by access control, else QueryError 'Unknown table' with suggestions, and it triggers deferred revenue-view and foreign-key builds.

The question asks where the structured record (the CacheMetrics NamedTuple with hit_counter, write_counter, bytes_counter, size_histogram) is defined; _get_cache_metrics is a lazy accessor function that returns it, not the definition.

The question asks where the bulk mutation invokes the helper. That is the call site, BaseBulkTranslateMutation.validate_translation_fields. The candidate is the helper itself, not the code that calls it.
__str__ formats a LicenseLedger entry as text with renewal/update type, licenses purchased, next-cycle count, and time.
SmartTubBuiltinSensor.native_value returns None for no state, the lowercased enum name if the state is an Enum, otherwise the lowercased string. This covers the ozone, UV and flow switch sensors.

The inputs for redirect URL and deactivation reason are defined in add_arguments, not handle; handle only reads them and calls do_add_deactivated_redirect, so it answers only the second half of the question.

access_token_expired compares the current time to refreshed_at + expires_in minus a half-life threshold, returning False if either config value is missing, which is exactly the expiry check that triggers a refresh.
When creating a new participant for an incident or case, it queries the contact plugin and sets location, team (falling back to the email domain) and department.
The file docstring says stable_chunks_choice decides which build a request gets, and the function picks it from query param, then cookie, then feature flag.
add_realm_logo_fields sets realm_logo_url/source and realm_night_logo_url/source in the state dict for both day and night variants.
In the update branch, when 'price' is in the input, it sets listing.discounted_price_amount equal to the new price as a placeholder until the celery task recalculates it.
The function decides that a $virt_ field needs the revenue_analytics join if it is in REVENUE_ANALYTICS_VIRTUAL_PROPERTIES, recursing through calls, binary operations and wrappers.
It updates stored values with user input and pops any Optional schema key missing from the input (except read_only selectors), clearing the previously saved value.
process_unsubscribe validates the confirmation key via get_object_from_key (handling ConfirmationKeyError) and then invokes the unsubscribe function, rendering the success page.
Command.verify_team delegates to verify_team_flags to check a single team's flags cache against the DB.

For a new instance (_state.adding) with a missing slug, it generates a unique slug from slugable_field via generate_unique_slug if that field is in the input, stores it under the slug key, and returns the modified cleaned_input dict.

It writes the `logged_in` activity entry on login. It also uses `was_impersonated` to pick the impersonator ID (`log_user.pk` when it differs from `user.pk`) and records `log_user or user` as the actor.
NonNullList wraps of_type in graphene.NonNull in __init__, which is the source of the automatic non-null item requirement; the failure behavior is left to graphene's NonNull handling.

AssigneeRef only converts assignee data to and from references and JSON; the snapshot creation and placement of the optional assignee and earliest first_seen into the record fields happen in IssueSnapshot.build (and record_issue_changes).
_disconnect closes the DB, memcached and RabbitMQ connections, and its comment says this is so forked children do not share them (Django reopens them as needed).
It builds the cache key as 'AppByTokenLoader:' plus the MD5 hexdigest of the UTF-8 encoded token string.
LimitDefinition is only the dataclass schema for one entry; the actual catalog with keys, descriptions, defaults and plan tier overrides is the REGISTRY dict (with LimitKey).
PhraseSearchFilter overrides get_search_terms to return the whole ?search= value as one term instead of splitting on whitespace, so DRF's SearchFilter matches it as a single literal substring.

AssignedAttribute.resolve_type is the interface type resolver that picks the concrete GraphQL type from the attribute's input_type and entity_type, using the single/multi reference maps and the general input-type map.
resolve_checkouts filters the checkout queryset by channel__slug only when channel_slug is truthy; otherwise it returns all checkouts.
redact_email_address replaces the local part of gateway addresses with X's and appends an annotation (missed message address, stream id, or invalid address), which is what the question describes.
ExistsError (code 'exists') is the error type used to report that a record already exists, such as a duplicate name.
It iterates over all scoped FileSystem rows, corrects depth, and bulk-creates missing parent folders, exactly as the question describes.
taxes_need_new_fetch directly decides whether cached Avatax data is stale by checking for a missing cache entry or request data that differs from the cached request.
Forms is the SQLAlchemy table model with form_data, status, attorney_status, attorney_analysis, and score columns linked to an incident.
This is the endpoint handler that serves a client's request for a channel's topic list, retrieving it via get_topic_history_for_stream or get_topic_history_for_public_stream after access checks.
str_to_enum only replaces spaces/hyphens with underscores and uppercases a string; the described behavior (class name + pk global ID, None for null/no pk) is in to_global_id_or_none.
get_recommendations catches FileNotFoundError when the model pickle is missing, logs a warning, and returns an empty list.
GET "" endpoint returns DocumentPagination via search_filter_sort_paginate, giving a paginated, searchable, sortable list of all documents.
It builds the message posted when a comment is removed, using COMMENT_REMOVE_TEMPLATE to produce '{user} has removed a comment.'

On a renamed summary, it removes the old item and adds a new one with a fresh uuid (ADD or COMPLETE by status), then refreshes the coordinator; it raises HomeAssistantError with todo_rename_item_failed on failure.
It is a context manager yielding a submit function that sends items one at a time to a process pool, with report callbacks and stops on first exception.
It sums each user's UserActivityInterval overlap (clipped to the window) in seconds, converts to whole minutes, and stores the result as UserCount rows via bulk_create.
get_screenshot_configs in zerver/lib/integrations.py takes an integration name and optional config options and returns a list of FixturelessScreenshotConfig objects (or None).
It iterates all status codes and each oneOf subschema variant, fetches examples, and formats each as a ``` json code block (with descriptions) for rendering.

It reads klass.__name__ and converts CamelCase to lowercase snake_case via regex, producing the entity type label used in class_queryset (as the 'type' column and for entity-specific branches); though the 'why required before queries' is only implicit.

diagnose_inactive_voucher checks channel listing and start_date first and returns NOT_FOUND for unlaunched or other-channel vouchers before any EXPIRED or USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED check, and its docstring explains why.
It filters open tasks with reminders enabled, past resolve_by, and last_reminder_at null or older than one day, matching the question exactly.
It emails project admins that workflow email sending limit was lowered for deliverability problems, including the per-day and per-hour limits.
Takes a property name parameter and returns json_extract_trim_quotes('properties', '%(name)s') as the extraction SQL fragment for the properties field.

perform_mutation only orchestrates and delegates; the actual logic for webhooks (product_variant_updated), search_index_dirty marking and mark_active_catalogue_promotion_rules_as_dirty lives in post_save_actions.
On bulk page type deletion it finds pages of those types, finds products whose attribute values reference those pages, and marks those products' search vectors dirty in batches.
SourceEnvironment is the SQLAlchemy table model and its __table_args__ UniqueConstraint on (name, project_id) enforces per-project unique names.
It raises CIMDValidationError when the declared com.posthog.scopes are non-empty but all non-grantable, rejecting the registration instead of widening to the default scope set.

The inner _supported function returns probe_number <= config[CONF_PROBE_COUNT], which is the per-probe check of whether to create an entity given the configured probe count; async_setup_entry applies it via entity_supported.
It collects order lines with no variant_id and adds a NOT_FOUND 'Product variant not found' error for each to the unavailable-variants errors, so they are reported and excluded from the checkout.

send_notifications_to_bouncer posts to push/notify, blocks on the response, deletes tokens the bouncer reports as failed, updates the sent-count stat, and sets realm push_notifications_enabled and end timestamp from the reply.
get_table_node tries the real table tree first, falls back to the models alias node when that raises ResolutionError, and re-raises the ResolutionError if neither resolves.

resolve_categories loads the promotion's predicate via PredicateByPromotionIdLoader and uses the 'categoryPredicate' category IDs to query Category objects, which is how a sale's categories are found now that sales are stored as promotions.

It computes old vs new available quantity (quantity - allocated) per stock to detect back-in-stock and out-of-stock transitions, and triggers the back/out-of-stock, stock-updated, and channel-level webhooks.
TicketPlugin is the base class defining the abstract create/update/delete interface that ticket (issue-tracker) plugins must implement.
It computes the pre-resubmit delay from the Retry-After header: 0 if missing, 1.0s if unparseable, otherwise clamped between 0 and the configured cap.
remove_member catches HttpError, treating 409 (not a member) and 404 (group missing) as non-fatal: it logs a debug message and returns None instead of raising.

MonitorMetadata is the metadata for monitoring a weblink in Slack interactions, carrying the weblink and plugin_instance_id on top of the base subject context (channel, thread, project, organization).

search_attribute_values only filters attribute values by name/slug ilike; it does not restrict attributes by product types of products in a category or collection (that is filter_attributes_by_product_types).

OrderLineInput is only a GraphQL input type with a quantity field; the described behavior (popping addresses/redirect_url/shipping method, resolving user by email, extracting channel, validating) is in DraftOrderCreate.clean_input.

check_update_max_invites is the predicate the support view uses to accept or reject a new max_invites value: it must exceed the plan default, or be 0/default only if it would actually change the current setting.

The question describes hogql_config_or_default (validates a raw dict into HogQLAlertConfig, defaulting to last_row config); extract is the extractor that fetches rows and builds an ExtractionResult, not that routine.
TaggedItem.delete sends model_activity_signal with activity='deleted', before_update=self and after_update=None, which is how removing a tag from an object gets recorded in the activity log.
StrictBaseModel sets model_config extra='ignore' and its docstring explains that extra fields are dropped because they could be XSS vectors.

common_context is documented as the shared context for outgoing emails without a request, built from the user's realm and profile, and it returns realm_url, realm_name, root_domain_url, external_url_scheme, external_host, user_name and corporate_enabled.
retry_event increments failed_tries, re-publishes the event to the queue, and calls failure_processor once MAX_REQUEST_RETRIES is exceeded.
SlackButton is just a dataclass for a link button's text/url/primary; the auto-join-on-not_in_channel mechanism lives in post_with_join and join_channel.
async_press forwards the press to all member buttons by calling the button.press service on the group's entity IDs, blocking until done.
It sends a private message from the notification bot to the user listing old/new values of changed profile fields, mentioning the acting admin or noting an automated change (e.g. LDAP sync).

EVENTS_TABLE_SQL creates the sharded ReplacingMergeTree data table (sharded_events), not a Distributed table for reads and writes across clusters; the Distributed tables come from DISTRIBUTED_EVENTS_TABLE_SQL and WRITABLE_EVENTS_TABLE_SQL.
It checks newly enabled auth methods against available_for_cloud_plans and raises JsonableError if the realm's plan_type isn't allowed.
ReadMessagesEvent is just a dataclass for 'mark as read' event payloads; the removal of push notifications for no-longer-mentioned users after an edit is done by do_update_mobile_push_notification.
comment_on_pull_request_from_url only parses a PR URL and posts a comment; the name-healing logic is in account_name_needs_heal/ensure_account_name/_fetch_and_store_account_name.
It decides whether a sender may use a stream-wide mention: allowed if subscriber count is at or below the threshold, otherwise depends on the sender's can_mention_many_users_group permission.

get_hot_topics picks the top 2 topics by number of distinct human senders (diversity), then fills up to 4 with the longest topics by human message count (length), balancing participants against length.

ColumnAliasedTableType.get_child maps the aliased column name to the original column via alias_to_original and delegates to the underlying table, which is the column lookup for FROM events AS e(a, b, c).
This GraphQL type defines the shape of each unavailable-item report returned to the client (message, code, variant_id, line_id) in the mutation's unavailable_variants field.
save() deletes postal code rules by id and creates new ones, raising an ALREADY_EXISTS ValidationError on IntegrityError for duplicate start/end.
It finds a top-level events $session_id IN/Eq literal UUID list in the outer WHERE and builds a session_id_v7 IN (_toUInt128(accurateCastOrNull(...))) predicate to prune the sessions join subquery.
delete_service catches IntegrityError on deletion and raises HTTP 409 saying the service is referenced by an incident Role and the reference must be removed first.
It builds the per-probe timer number entity in minutes (duration, 0-720), reading time from PacketA8Notify and sending it via PacketA7Write with timedelta(minutes=value).
It queues the invitation email, then schedules an invitation_reminder via send_future_email when the invite expires in 4 or more days.
The task refreshes the activity log fields cache for large orgs, and its `flush` flag chooses between a full sampled rebuild and an incremental pass over the last `hours_back` hours.
append_select, when aggregate=True, passes the expression (or the inner expr of an Alias) through _transform_column, then calls super().append_select to add it to the _selects list.
bulk_create loads each row's tag and calls sync_team(), which sets team_id from the tag's team, since bulk_create never calls save().

Its docstring matches the question: it creates the preregistration user, applies the invite options, and builds the USER_REGISTRATION confirmation link for the user to complete registration. The email itself is sent by the caller, not by this function.
create_tag_type catches IntegrityError on duplicate name and raises a ValidationError wrapping ExistsError 'A tag type with this name already exists.' on field 'name'.
The task is the hourly (minute 50) periodic entry point, and its docstring and time_limit comment cover the lock-based skip. The lock-key deletion is only in the helper it calls.
perform_mutation is the mutation entry point: it loads the voucher, calls add_catalogues_to_node to add the products, categories and collections, and fires the voucher_updated event.
create() builds an MS Teams client, creates the meeting, and returns the joinWebUrl as 'weblink' plus id for the conference workflow.
get_all just returns a query of case severities and raises nothing; the 'No default case severity defined.' error comes from get_default_or_raise.
POST login_sessions/revoke_others revokes all of the user's login sessions except the current request's session, matching the question.
date_range_since_last_flush just returns a (start, end) datetime tuple or None; the function that sanitizes broken Unicode is replace_broken_unicode.
validate_schema recursively checks every object schema for an 'additionalProperties' key and raises SchemaError if it is missing.
mark_clients_offline marks long-lived (e.g. mobile) queues offline after the 10-minute idle timeout and fires missedmessage_hook to send notifications without expiring the queue.
ThumbnailField.__init__ only injects size and format arguments into the field; the absolute-URL conversion happens in Image.resolve_url (and File.resolve_url).
vimeo_id extracts a Vimeo video ID from a URL via regex; it does no tree traversal, processor calls, or result collection (that is walk_tree).
resolve_page returns the linked page only if the requestor is active with MANAGE_PAGES permission or the page is_visible; otherwise returns None.
The question describes get_hosts_content (sorts host dicts by hostname and concatenates formatted rows); extract_friendly_name only derives a job name from the payload and does not handle host lists.
fetch_api_key gets iago's example email, derives the password via initial_password, and returns a dict with 'username' (email) and 'password' keys for the /fetch_api_key login example.
It maps the user's role via SYSTEM_USER_GROUP_ROLE_MAP to the matching built-in system group in the user's realm and returns it.
It filters weight-based shipping methods to those where minimum_order_weight <= weight (or null) and maximum_order_weight >= weight (or null), exactly the range-covers-weight check.
get_incidents only lists incidents with pagination; the error for failed deletion (HTTP 500 'could not be deleted... relationships to other incidents or cases') is raised in delete_incident.

merge_streams moves messages to the kept stream's recipient, clears their cache keys via bulk_delete_cache_keys, deactivates subscriptions on the destroyed stream, adds users who were only on it to the surviving stream, and deactivates the stream.
For a monthly schedule it returns one twelfth of the fixed price, rounded via format_money and converted back to cents, instead of the full fixed price.
_to_week defines the table of the ten modes (0-9) and builds the CASE over the mode for both toWeek and toYearWeek (include_year) in Trino SQL.

After the update/create loop, it fetches all existing policies for the role and project via get_all_by_role, and deletes any whose id isn't in the submitted/updated list (for/else with db_session.delete).

get_person_name is only a thin wrapper that passes the person's pk, properties, distinct_ids and the team to get_person_name_helper. The logic that decides the priority (team display-name properties first, then non-UUID distinct IDs, then pk) is in the helper, not in this symbol.
It iterates over product-type attribute assignments and adds an ATTRIBUTE_CANNOT_BE_ASSIGNED error whenever variant_selection is true, which is exactly the rejection the question describes.
post_save_action reloads the product from the DB by pk, gets the plugin manager from the request context, and calls call_event with manager.product_created.

save() changes the user's password and, if the marketing emails checkbox was ticked and the setting was off, enables enable_marketing_emails, which covers the password change and the account-setting side effect.

This type only defines the shape of an unavailable-variant entry (message, code, variant_id, line_id) and has nothing specific to deleted variants; the NOT_FOUND 'Product variant not found' reporting for lines with no variant is in handle_not_found_variants.
It computes the base checkout total, wraps it as TaxedMoney, returns it untaxed (quantized) if <= zero, otherwise runs plugins to compute the taxed total.
WeightScalar.serialize calls convert_weight_to_default_weight_unit on a Weight and returns its string form for the GraphQL response.
handle sets the redirect URL if given, skips with a message if the realm is already deactivated, otherwise deactivates the realm (optionally emailing owners).
is_renderable only reports whether a field type (SHORT_TEXT/PARAGRAPH) is renderable; the per-user value is stored in CustomProfileFieldValue, not this method.
The mapping itself is defined in the module-level _MYSQL_CAST_TYPES dict; this method only looks up a type name in it and raises on unsupported targets.
CTETableType.has_child only checks whether a named column exists on the CTE's table; the nested-property decision (JSON, array or struct fields) is made in FieldType.get_child.
Checkout.resolve_subtotal_price loads the price calculation via the dataloader, then takes checkout_info.checkout.subtotal, quantizes it to the currency, and returns it.
It reads a .partial file, pulls out the messages, user profile ids and realm id, applies the consent export settings through fetch_usermessages, and writes the table data to the .json output.
It creates a public warehouse named '... for click and collect' with click_and_collect_option set to WarehouseClickAndCollectOption.LOCAL_STOCK, and attaches a shipping zone and channel.

ensure_account_name is the entry point that replaces a placeholder (numeric installation ID) account name with the real GitHub login, using a cooldown and a claim lock, and it delegates the fetch and store to _fetch_and_store_account_name.

serve_file does the orchestration: it picks serve_local or serve_s3 by settings.LOCAL_UPLOADS_DIR, renders thumbnails, and returns a signed token URL when url_only is set. It never uses the avatar directory flag, which only appears in serve_local_avatar_unauthed.
It checks the path is a string, rejects it if longer than MAX_PATH_LENGTH characters or deeper than MAX_PATH_SEGMENTS levels, before the per-segment folder creation loop.
It handles the rendered state: the string "None" becomes None, and for date/timestamp/uptime device classes the value is parsed into a date/datetime object.
trace_condition.__exit__ catches an exception raised during condition evaluation and records it on the trace element via set_error, which is where the error is stored in the trace.
validate_instance raises a ValidationError on the 'id' field with message "Couldn't resolve to Checkout or Order: {id}" and code NOT_FOUND when the instance is neither a Checkout nor an Order.
It applies a regex to raw_message['content'] to find @username mentions and maps them to user IDs via user_id_mapper.
build_message_send_dict gathers stream/topic target, recipient info, and notification user-id sets into a SendMessageRequest (the dict passed to do_send_messages) with keyword fields for each aspect.
It implements the step filter: funnel_step >= 0 means converted (step_reached >= funnel_step), negative means drop-off (step_reached >= N-1 and < N).

It is the rename hook: it finds the flag's system-generated total-volume and unique-calls insights on the usage dashboard by name and calls _update_tile_with_new_key to rewrite the old key to the new one.
This function calls missing_any_realm_internal_bots and creates bots if missing; the actual check of whether any realm lacks its internal bots is in missing_any_realm_internal_bots.
This property returns weather alert phenomenon colors for the alert sensor; the next-rain-in-the-hour logic is in MeteoFranceRainSensor.native_value.
check_server_incompatibility computes the is_incompatible value in api_get_server_settings: true when the parsed User-Agent name is 'ZulipInvalid'.
It returns None for a missing file and catches any parse/validation error, logs a warning, captures the exception and returns None, so the opt-in is disabled and pages render as before.
log_errors returns early unless skip_validation is set, then builds a dict of invalid fields (exposing only whitelisted values) and logs it via logger.warning('Invalid address input: %s').

emit_sync_alert holds the branch: only events in EVENTS_PRODUCED_ONLY_FOR_SUBSCRIBERS (just COMPLETED) get the subscriber check, so a FAILED event with no subscriber skips it and is produced, with outcome 'produced'.
access_token_expired returns True once the current time passes refreshed_at + expires_in minus half of expires_in (the half-life threshold), so the token is refreshed well before its real expiry.
async_media_pause checks whether PAUSE is missing and PLAY_PAUSE is present in the controls, and if so calls client.play_pause() (the toggle) instead of client.pause().
is_challenge_handshake only checks whether the payload type is 'url_verification' for Slack's setup handshake; the mention and channel conversion is done by convert_slack_user_and_channel_mentions.
It creates a warning repair issue (model_deprecated) with a learn-more link when any configured subentry's chat model has lifecycle deprecated or retired, and deletes it otherwise.

The `error` property filters past errors to those matching the current code, then prefers the first active match and falls back to the first match overall, which is how details are picked among duplicate codes.

allocate_ids reserves new IDs by calling nextval on the table's id sequence (found via idseq) count times, so the starting point is the sequence's current value and existing rows are never collided with.
find_existing_mutations queries system.mutations, matching each rendered ALTER command text and returning the existing mutation IDs, which __call__ uses to decide what still needs enqueueing.
get_user_info looks up the Zulip user by the Bitbucket account_id via guess_zulip_user_from_external_account and returns a silent mention, falling back to display_name, nickname, or 'Unknown user'.
The question describes add_arguments, which registers the --progress, --skip-delay and --reset-level options on the parser; handle only consumes the parsed options and does not define them.
do_scrub_realm anonymizes user names and emails, deletes messages and avatars, removes custom profile fields, and deletes all attachments for the realm.
get() merges domain, then glob, then exact values via successive result.update calls, so exact overrides glob, which overrides domain.
OrderFilterInput is the filter input type for orders: it sets filterset_class = OrderFilter (the source of the filter options) and defines the payment_status field.
It generates a presigned or public download URL for a realm's export tarball stored in S3, using the export bucket or the avatar bucket as a fallback.

It counts team Integration and UserIntegration rows for a GitHub installation id, returns an int (sum of both counts), and the exclude_team_integration_id and exclude_user_integration_id keyword args skip the respective rows.

construct_instance here is a no-op stub (pass) that only serves as a hook for subclasses; it does not itself assemble the entry from cleaned data, and the question's described behavior is not implemented by it.
When get_by_name returns no alert, the function raises a pydantic ValidationError wrapping a NotFoundError with msg 'Alert not found.' for loc 'alert'.

move_file_confluence issues the Confluence REST PUT to /content/{page_id}/move/append/{parent_id}, which relocates the newly created page under the parent; copy_file calls it right after creating the page.

The base class only wraps the mutate response and defines clean_product; the orchestration of adding products, categories, collections and variants lives in VoucherAddCatalogues.add_catalogues_to_node, and the early abort comes from clean_product's validation error.
validate() calls super().validate() and then, if source_query_runner is not None, calls source_query_runner.validate(), so the source's state is checked as part of the overall validation.
get_meta looks through the case type's plugin_metadata list and returns the entry whose slug matches the given plugin slug.
It handles the reauth confirm step: validates the new API key via list_companies, shows errors on failure, otherwise updates the entry data, schedules a reload, and aborts with reauth_successful.
It compares the topic's messages against the move time limit and raises MessageMoveError when some messages are too old to move with propagate_mode change_all.
When days_remaining is below CERT_EXPIRY_WARN_DAYS, it picks a 'retry' remediation if is_cloudflare, otherwise a 'config' remediation telling the user to contact support.

In the elif branch for a case with a thread conversation that now has a dedicated channel, it updates the conversation record to the channel, logs a migration event, updates the original thread message, posts a migration notice in the old thread linking to the new channel, and posts a message in the new channel linking back to the thread.
It groups listeners by (start_date, end_date) range and schedules one fetch per distinct range, so dashboards viewing the same dates share a single event fetch when the calendar changes.
_set_minimum reads the current maximum from the probe's A8 notify packet via _get_temperatures (TEMPERATURE_RANGE) and passes it unchanged into PacketA300Write alongside the new minimum.
It returns True when any series uses a first-time math or retention type is first-time, which is exactly what forces reading from the project's first event regardless of date range.

The activity loads the EvaluationReport (with its evaluation) from Postgres via select_related and computes period_start/period_end (now as end; start from last_delivered_at, a lookback period, or the Nth eval timestamp) for the report window.
It returns 'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS' for the model's distributed table, `distributed_posthog_document_embeddings_<normalized_model_name>`, which is the drop operation and the table it targets.
It creates a CustomerEvent with user=user and type=CustomerEvents.ACCOUNT_CREATED, exactly the recording of new account creation asked about.
generate_sale_payload builds the sale-updated webhook body with categories/collections/products/variants added and removed computed from previous vs current catalogue.
It builds the Postgres SQL over posthog_hogfunction filtered by o.is_ai_data_processing_approved and non-deleted, with LIMIT/OFFSET paging and a stable ORDER BY using hog as tiebreaker.
EmbeddedBotWorker.get_bot_api_client is the method in the embedded bots worker that creates the EmbeddedBotHandler client a bot uses to interact with the server.
It looks up subscriptions via client.get_subscriptions() and builds and returns a list of stream (channel) IDs from them.
extract_data iterates meta tags and pulls og:title, og:description, and og:image into UrlEmbedData for link previews.
It picks the custom generated function when weights are set or an indexed column has a vectorizer, and otherwise returns the built-in tsvector_update_trigger call.
_update_warehouses only adds/removes warehouse relations and returns a modified flag; it does not persist the instance (that happens in _save/perform_mutation), so it covers only half the question.
cache_delete_many combines all cache key prefixes with the items, processes them in batches of 10000, validates each key, and calls the backend's delete_many on each batch.

It only returns realm.first_visible_message_id; it doesn't show where that value comes from or that it is 0 when the realm has fewer messages than the limit — that logic is in update_first_visible_message_id.
_async_toggle pushes the value to the device, on success optimistically updates the read key with the on/off read value, and on failure raises HomeAssistantError with a write_error translation.
TestParticipantGroupPlugin is the no-op test plugin implementing ParticipantGroupPlugin (create/add/remove all return nothing), standing in for real participant group/mailing list integrations.
Products with a null collection sort_order get a value one less than the current minimum sort_order, so they are placed before (at the start of) the explicitly positioned products.
The candidate is only an @overload type stub (body is '...'); it has no logic for routing to a query runner or returning results, which lives in the actual implementation of process_query_model.
Before setting the new default billing/shipping address, it adds the existing default to user.addresses so the old default stays in the address book.
get_instance_channel_id raises a ValidationError on the 'channel' field with 'Channel id is required.' and code OrderErrorCode.REQUIRED when channel_id is missing from the input.
MenuItemCreate.save calls acquire_menu_item_tree_lock() inside a transaction right before instance.save() when creating a new item.

check_permissions grants access with MANAGE_CHANNELS, otherwise maps order/checkout/payment settings keys to MANAGE_ORDERS/MANAGE_CHECKOUTS/HANDLE_PAYMENTS and requires those permissions only if the input contains only settings fields.

email_not_system_bot raises a ValidationError when the email is a cross-realm system bot address, and it is attached as a validator on RealmCreationForm.email, so it blocks such emails during organization creation.
PersonStrategy.order_by picks the sort property: team.person_display_name_properties[0] if configured, otherwise 'email', for orderBy 'person' (ASC/DESC).
ReportTacticalBlockIds defines the Slack block IDs for the tactical report's needs, actions, and conditions fields.
ProbeWindow is a dataclass of time bounds for probes; the function that scans product modules and returns specs as a tuple is discover_data_sources.
dispatch skips handlers whose subject differs from the context subject type (incident/case) and those whose event subtype is in the exclude list, via continue statements.
It returns true only when the message is private, has exactly one recipient, and that recipient's id equals the sender's id.

It builds the SQL that counts max active parts per (host, partition) on the raw sessions table, which is what's compared against parts_to_throw_insert to detect a merge backlog that could block inserts.
It computes an HMAC of the payload using the webhook secret from the URL and compares it in constant time to the provided signature, verifying origin and integrity.
patch_executor replaces executor.complete_value_catching_error with a wrapper that uses allow_writer_in_context, enabling writer DB access during field resolution in mutations.
handle implements the --reset-level option, which sets zulip_update_announcements_level for all active non-system-bot realms to the given level.
It sums UserCount values for the given user and this stat's property between the start of the current month and the start of next month, which is the user's running total for the month.
On first save (no pk), it takes the max fulfillment_order among the order's existing fulfillments and sets the new value to max+1, or 1 if none exist.
The handler for User model activity signals (create/update) iterates over all of the user's organization memberships and bulk-logs an entry to each organization.

It decides recipients of the deactivation event: all active users if access isn't restricted, otherwise non-guests, DM-involved users, and shared DM-group subscribers, with guests lacking access getting group-removal events or remove events.
SourceTypePagination defines the paginated list response shape for source types, extending Pagination with items: List[SourceTypeRead].

perform_mutation calls remove_the_oldest_user_address_if_address_limit_is_reached(user) before adding the new address, so at the limit the oldest address is removed and the new one is added instead of raising an error.

It is the hook that supplies the variant suffix (default empty, overridden by subclasses), and its docstring says the state goes in as a key suffix and also reaches runtime_hash. It doesn't show the hash-versus-key split itself.
It returns the most recent Report for a given incident id and report type (tactical or executive), ordered by created_at desc with first().
It maps the lowercase funnel window unit to a ClickHouse unit string, defaults to 'DAY' when the unit is None, and raises ValidationError for unsupported units.
It copies the transaction and sets cc_first_digits, cc_last_digits, cc_exp_month and cc_exp_year to None before returning it, so the public summary hides card digits and expiration date.

get_hedgehog_config flattens user.hedgehog_config into use_as_profile/color/accessories/skin, reading from actor_options for version 2 and from top-level keys otherwise, for the nested user serializer.

PhraseSearchFilter overrides get_search_terms to return the whole query as a single term, so 'NON PROD' is matched as one literal substring and not split into independent terms, which is the exact behavior asked about.

sync() builds the config, saves it to the DB (config and synced_at), updates the hypercache (Redis), purges the CDN, and records the outcome (success, no_changes or failure) on the CELERY_TASK_REMOTE_CONFIG_SYNC counter. The force flag also matches the question's 'forces' wording.

It creates a deactivated placeholder realm on the old subdomain with a deactivated redirect to the new URL, repoints existing placeholders from earlier renames, and its docstring and session deletion explain how existing clients are affected.
When an item is set as default, it queries the project's existing default (if different from the target) and sets its default to False, then commits.

The function adds order, lines, meta and warehouse_address, but it never saves an order token as a graphql node ID; the only to_global_id use for an order is in generate_order_payload, and that is a different function.
WildValueDict.__getitem__ only does dict key lookup and wrapping; the '%(username)s' count check is in check_external_account_url_pattern.
It sends one message containing a URL and one without, then calls /messages/matches_narrow with a 'has: link' narrow as the API doc example.
It encrypts the API key by XORing its hex encoding with a one-time pad, which is the protection applied before the key is sent to the mobile app via the zulip:// redirect.
It increments activity per message and, once an observer reaches 3 messages, renounces the observer role, adds the participant role, and logs the change.
The __init__ parses the trailing hyphen-separated numeric segment of model_name as the dimension when none is given, and raises ValueError if it can't.
It picks the topic name ('signups', localized) and switches it to an empty string when the announcement stream's topics_policy is empty_topic_only, then sends the message.
Checkout.resolve_available_collection_points loads the checkout lines and calls get_valid_collection_points_for_checkout to compute the warehouses available for click-and-collect.
AccountOperationBase.resolve_channel reads channel_slug from the stored event data and looks up the Channel by that slug, returning None if absent.
It computes and assigns the next sequential sort_order to the attribute value, using the attribute's max_sort_order counter or calculating it if unset; save() calls it when sort_order is None.

need_accept_tos returns False for no user or when TERMS_OF_SERVICE_VERSION is unset, True if the user has not yet logged in for the first time or if the setting's major version exceeds the user's accepted major version.

It builds the INSERT...SELECT backfill from session_replay_events and adds a modulo(cityHash64(session_id UUID as UInt128), num_shards) = shard_index filter so each shard only selects its own recordings.
This receiver on OAuthApplication model activity filters for scope changes (and provisioning config) and calls log_activity to record the audit entry.
It records cache hit/miss via a labeled Prometheus counter and returns early when is_cache_warming() is true, so warming requests are excluded.

It builds and sends the 'user_group' event with op 'add', attaching group details (name, creator_id, date_created, members, description, id, is_system_group, direct_subgroup_ids, permission settings, deactivated) plus for_reactivation.
validate_login checks email/password, uses the MFA code if provided (else plain login), then fetches the subscription id and returns it with the session token.
It handles the account-delete notify event by choosing the delete template and subject and dispatching send_account_delete_confirmation_email_task, which is the email sent when deletion is requested.
It returns all non-deactivated (non-archived) streams in a realm, explicitly including invite-only ones.
ProductCreate.save, inside traced_atomic_transaction, sets search_index_dirty=True, saves the product, and stores attribute values via AttributeAssignmentMixin.save.
get_repo_name checks for 'project', then 'repository', then falls back to 'group' to pick the section and return the name.
update_feature_flag_dashboard is the entry point that finds the flag's system-generated insights on its usage dashboard and updates them with the new key after a rename.

It checks eligibility (skips if voucher or manual discount), sets base prices, computes subtotal and country, then calls create_discount_objects_for_order_promotions to create the order-promotion discount objects, clearing them if none apply.
AttributeValueTranslationInput is only an input type defining rich_text/plain_text fields; the ChannelContext wrapping occurs in AttributeValueTranslate.perform_mutation.
When a refund reverse event exists, it adds reverse.amount_value back to charged_value and subtracts it from refunded_value, then runs the base recalculation for the other refund events.
UserProfile.set_password calls check_password_strength and raises PasswordTooWeakError if the password is weak, before calling super().set_password to store it.
resolve_actions builds the list of available order actions (CAPTURE, MARK_AS_PAID, REFUND, VOID) by checking order.can_capture/can_mark_as_paid/can_refund/can_void against the order's payments.
It generates the path, stores the file via the backend, creates the Attachment record, and returns the '/user_uploads/<path_id>' URL path and the filename.
async_load_platform sets up the component if not loaded and, if setup fails, returns early without dispatching the platform-discovered signal.
execute_hog detects a single-line source, prepends 'return' (unless it already has return or ':='), appends ';', then parses, compiles and runs it so the expression value is returned.

The question describes cleanup(), which finishes the running handler and then garbage-collects the queue. finish_current_handler only finishes the handler and disconnects it, and has no GC step or GC context.
ScheduledMessage.to_dict converts a scheduled message into the API stream or direct message TypedDict.

It collects messages with ts after last_forwarded_ts and before the arriving event, and when more than max_messages (50) piled up it keeps only the most recent ones and adds a truncation note to the header.

It computes, for a DM with guest recipients in a user-access-restricted realm, which users newly gain access to which guests (excluding those already sharing DMs or subscriptions), returning a map of user to newly visible user IDs.
This is the on_close callback for an established connection: it logs a warning, resets the failure count to 1, and schedules _reconnect after 2 seconds on the IOLoop.
It returns entry.area_id if set, otherwise looks up the entity's device and returns the device's effective area via dr.async_get_effective_area_id (None if no device).
parse_semver splits off everything after the first hyphen, defaults missing minor/patch to "0", and returns SemverParts(major, minor, patch), so '1.2.3-beta' gives 1, 2, 3.

On a cache read exception it logs a warning and returns None; on a non-string or invalid stored payload it also returns None. The caller then treats that as a miss and asks the model again, so the check is not lost.
render_playground only builds URLs and renders the playground template; the HTTP-method routing between playground and query execution is in GraphQLView.dispatch.

validate_plugin_configuration collects blank username/password and ship-from address fields and raises a PLUGIN_MISCONFIGURED ValidationError when the plugin is being activated, then also checks authentication.
It wraps the trigger action so that, when it fires, the conf's CONF_VARIABLES are rendered with the run variables and merged into them before the action is called.

It returns a 404 'link_does_not_exist' page when the invite's realm differs from the request's realm, and on an expired or invalid key it renders the confirmation key error if the realm is missing or invite-only, otherwise it falls through to the normal accounts home page.

The question describes the main mutation handler (perform_mutation), which orchestrates validation, payment details, money handling, creation, event logging and returns the result; create_transaction only builds and saves the TransactionItem.
validate_variants calls validate_product_is_published_in_channel and validate_variant_channel_listings for the order's channel before lines are added, remapping errors.
It deletes ScheduledEmail rows of type INVITATION_REMINDER filtered by address (case-insensitive), which is how pending invitation reminders are cancelled for an address with no user object.
failure_rate divides orgs_failed by orgs_attempted (processed + failed), which excludes orgs_skipped from the denominator, with a zero-guard.
It filters price-based shipping methods by channel and by whether the order total falls within each listing's minimum/maximum order price (null limits treated as unbounded).
generate_exception_response builds the JsonResponse with type/code/detail/attr in the drf-exceptions-hog format specifically for endpoints not under DRF.
EmbeddedBotHandler.get_config_info catches ConfigError when no config exists and returns an empty dict if optional is True, otherwise re-raises.
It directly determines whether the user may move messages between channels by checking membership in the realm's can_move_messages_between_channels_group permission setting.
It marks an Issue as 'sub_issue' when 'parentId' is in payload data, and returns None for IGNORED_EVENTS (IssueLabel, Project, ProjectUpdate, Cycle, Reaction), which are silently dropped.
render_incoming_message only renders message markdown; the rate limiting of bot-owner DM error notifications is in send_rate_limited_pm_notification_to_bot_owner (5-minute wait via last_reminder).
parse_literal handles inline literal values; on JSONDecodeError or TypeError from malformed JSON it swallows the error and returns None.
filter_order_by_payment narrows the order queryset to orders whose payments__pk equals the given payment id, and returns the queryset unchanged when the id is falsy.
When LOCAL_UPLOADS_DIR is None, it emits zulip.E005 errors if S3_AUTH_UPLOADS_BUCKET or S3_AVATAR_BUCKET is empty, which blocks startup.

It regex-extracts the function's body from javascript_examples.js, pulls the code_example start/end snippets, and wraps them in an `(async () => { const client = await zulipInit(config); ... })();` block.
_aware_utc handles epoch seconds (int/float), ISO strings, naive datetimes (assumed UTC) and tz-aware ones (converted to UTC), covering every case in the question.
flush_submessage deletes the parent message's cached message_dict entry whenever a SubMessage (poll vote/widget interaction data) is saved, since submessages are cached as part of the parent message.
update_organization is the PUT endpoint guarded by OrganizationOwnerPermission and converts an IntegrityError from a duplicate name into a pydantic ValidationError on 'name'.

It builds the expression: returns a direct quoted materialized column lookup (table_alias."col", True) when denormalized props are allowed, a non-nullable materialized column exists, and the column isn't a group column; otherwise returns trim_quotes_expr(JSONExtractRaw(...)), False.
It computes the charge_taxes value in product webhook payloads: true if the product's tax class (or its product type's) has any non-zero country rate.
interactive_debug is the signal handler that opens a Python InteractiveConsole with the frame's globals and locals, and it is registered for SIGUSR2 in interactive_debug_listen.
RoborockSensorEntityA01 is a generic sensor for A01 devices (wet/dry vacs, washing machines) that reads a protocol value; the current-room report is done by RoborockCurrentRoom.
It checks whether the payment has a successful REFUND_ONGOING transaction, and complete_checkout_post_payment_part calls it before creating the order.
It queries for problems with the given IDs that don't belong to caller_app and raises ValidationError 'Cannot dismiss problems belonging to other apps.'
This resolver for the `customers` field applies search rank sorting validation, prefix search, filtering, and builds a paginated connection slice.
validate_token looks up a token in TOKEN_VALIDATION_MAPPING and returns the human-readable error such as 'Card expired' or 'Insufficient funds'.
EditorJSListDataModel.to_text raises ValidationError when current_depth exceeds max_depth while recursively converting nested list items to plain text.
is_stream only reads the stored _msg_type; what decides the stream-vs-private marking is the msg_type passed to __init__ (set by the for_stream*/for_private* factories and legacy_build).
get_checkout_line_tax_rate is the checkout-line tax rate lookup, and its signature shows the required arguments: checkout_info, lines, checkout_line_info, address and previous_value.
It iterates through nested and/or/not groups, collects entity ids from time before/after bounds, and handles zone conditions, entity_id fields, and targets.

The function queries the table by stat and key, stores values in value_dicts (subgroup -> end_time -> count), and builds value_arrays keyed by label, with lists of counts in end_times order; this matches the question.
get_hypercache_config only returns the config constant; the command's entry point is the handle method.
It sends the password reset email via SendGrid with the reset template and then records the customer_password_reset_link_sent_event for the user.
TaxClass is the basic tax category record, and its __str__ returns self.name, so the text produced is the tax class's name.
It builds the dropdown label for a Vélo'v station (name, optional address/commune in parentheses, then station number) used in the add-station subentry flow.

_is_property_hidden only checks whether an event property is marked hidden, and it is used in the values endpoint. The list endpoint's filter and order-by rejection is done by _reject_restricted_property_references.

get_delivery_for_webhook looks up a single delivery by id (via get_multiple_deliveries_for_webhooks) and returns a not_found boolean that is True only when the delivery is missing and was not flagged inactive.
generate_cache_key builds the key by SHA-256 hashing the raw query and prefixing the Saleor version, optionally appending GRAPHQL_CACHE_SUFFIX.
InternalEvent is just a dataclass holding team_id, event and person; the alert-reserved check is the function is_managed_alert_internal_event.
datetime_picker_block parses a 'date|HH:MM' string, zero-pads single-digit hours, and passes the date, hour and minute as initial values to the three pickers.
It computes the group state from member states: all unknown/unavailable gives None (unknown), all identical gives that state, any non-off member gives ON, otherwise OFF.

to_representation overwrites data['variants'] with the output of _get_corrected_variants, which is why the serialized list shows merged flag and experiment data. The merging itself happens in the helper.
resolve_parent loads the parent menu item by parent_id via MenuItemByIdLoader and wraps it in ChannelContext with the root's channel_slug, preserving the channel.
get_prep_value is the Django hook that prepares a value for DB storage, and it coerces the value to str and returns self.encrypt(value), an encrypted string.
setup_platform skips any sensor whose name contains the name of a TEMPERATURE-type actuator (a thermostat/climate entity), so those readings are not added as standalone sensors.

The question targets the routine that finds product attribute assignments and marks product rows dirty (update_products_search_index); perform_mutation only orchestrates deletion and calls it, not itself applying the state change.
get_access_token checks access_token_expired(), calls refresh_access_token() if expired, then returns sensitive_config['access_token'] (empty string if missing).
DateTime.parse_value rejects values at MINYEAR/MAXYEAR whose astimezone(UTC) conversion raises OverflowError, returning None so BC-era timestamps aren't stored.
It decides version readiness by checking via s3_head that the version's array.js exists in the S3 bucket, and it returns False when the artifact is absent or no bucket is configured.
It sends the email-change request email via SendGrid using the change-request template and then records customer_email_change_request_event with old_email and new_email.
The __init__ sets self.wait = random.randint(5, 20), so clients are told to wait a random 5-20 seconds before retrying when ClickHouse is at capacity.
async_setup_entry checks has_sleep_timer() and then light_type before adding the light timer sensor, which is exactly the decision asked about.
This property decides whether persons-on-events v2 reads are enabled; it does not clear the backup secret API token or delete a project secret key (that is delete_secret_token_backup_and_save).
CheckoutMutations is the class in the GraphQL schema that declares checkout mutation fields, including checkout_create = CheckoutCreate.Field(), and lists all exposed fields.
The function appends '.png' to the URL's path if the path doesn't already end with '.png', then rebuilds the URL.
async_added_to_hass only calls super and then _async_handle_event; the timestamp-based deduplication and the last_activity_by lookup are implemented in _async_handle_event, not in this method.
Its docstring says 'Synchronous fast-path repo resolution before the discovery agent runs' and it defines the result type with auto/no_repo/agent_needed modes.
wait_for_patch_part_replication sleeps for the grace period so other replicas can fetch the patch part after a lightweight delete/update sweep, before data is read again.
PersonStrategy.filter_conditions applies person/cohort-type team test account filters when filterTestAccounts is set, and builds the ILIKE search conditions across email, name, id and distinct_id.

This handler processes the signal engagement approval modal submission (MFA challenge, posting response). It has nothing to do with promoting an observer to participant after a message-count threshold.
RateLimitedUser.rules parses the user's custom rate_limits string (for the api_by_user domain) into (seconds, requests) rules and only falls back to settings.RATE_LIMITING_RULES when none is set.

resolve_quantity_available computes the per-checkout quantity (global limit, preorder thresholds, or stock loaders) and switches between the shipping-zone loader and the channel-only warehouse loader based on use_legacy_shipping_zone_stock_availability.
Order.can_cancel checks that all fulfillments are in canceled/refunded/replaced/returned states and that the order status is not canceled, draft or expired.
assign_pending_columns finds BACKFILL slots stamped with a different run_id (stranded), logs a warning, and reports them via posthoganalytics.capture_exception.
It decides whether a user may access a stream's pre-join history: web-public, realm-public history for non-guests, or subscriber-only history with an access check.
It directly decides whether the log file is disabled: returns 'supervisor' when SUPERVISOR is set without HA_DUPLICATE_LOG_FILE, or 'environment' when HA_DISABLE_LOG_FILE is truthy.
When JWT_MANAGER_PATH is unset or empty, the method raises ImportError with the message 'Missing setting value for JWT Manager path - JWT_MANAGER_PATH'.
async_setup_entry loads the config-entry group, resolves member IDs via er.async_validate_entity_ids against the registry (filtering stale ones), then adds the SwitchGroup.

should_keep_join is the predicate that decides whether a lazy join to another table survives schema pruning, and it deliberately keeps joins whose string-named target is access-denied so resolution raises TableAccessDeniedError instead of 'Field not found'.
delete_team is the DELETE endpoint that looks up the team contact, raises HTTP 404 if missing, and otherwise deletes it.
process_view sets request._graphql_view = True when the resolved view class is a GraphQLView subclass, which is exactly where a request is flagged as targeting the GraphQL endpoint.
It raises a CANNOT_REMOVE_FROM_LAST_GROUP ValidationError when the requestor is in the group being deleted and has only one group.
